objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, reactivated, and translated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default name includes document type abbreviation, consecutive number per type, and title.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status such as editing, released, out of force, or invalidated.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property maintained for targeted storage and linking.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained for targeted storage and linking.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment used to grant reader authorization.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person assigned as author and workflow creator signer.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Person assigned additional change rights without release workflow relevance.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person assigned to check the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person assigned to release the document.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification of a document such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in the default document name.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be checked for documents of the type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period after which archived documents of the type are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating a new document.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created for editing, release, revision, reactivation, or translated content.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle status of the version.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, released with the main document, versioned, and archived with the next released version when marked for archiving.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the main release cycle and published directly through properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal belonging to a document and managed without affecting document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Processing state of the change proposal.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate and archive a released document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created by the Business Admin group to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, or acknowledgement recipient.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for authorizations, reader access, distribution, archive access, and role-specific availability.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained per document containing user groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Workflow-supported confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not visible.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_template
evts.description: A document template is selected when creating a new document object.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Standardized and customer-specific document metadata are maintained in the document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Document content is edited using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: The edited document is saved.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF and displayed on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group-related and person-related authorizations are assigned in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document as a document attachment.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released and published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is changed.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: A released attachment is marked for archiving.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment marked for archiving is archived with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: A new editing version is created when a released document is revised or triggering changes occur.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The three-step release process is started by an author or co-author after creation and maintenance.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creator workflow step.

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete the review task positively.

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: An assigned releaser completes the release task positively.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: A review or release rejection cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights user creates a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The document author documents the editing of assigned change proposals in the proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A completed change proposal is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared, the request is deleted, and the document Valid Until date is updated.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A request for override is created for a document that must be withdrawn from circulation.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: A document and its attachments are declared invalid, archived, and given out-of-force status.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, archived documents are physically deleted.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group user creates a request for reactivation and selects the document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new document version and restoring authorizations and attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to the document distribution list.

evts.name: send_email_distribution
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned user groups are informed by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Assigned persons and users of assigned user groups are requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released content or a released document is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, the clients where it is visible or not visible are specified.

o2o.description: Each created document is assigned a selected document type.
One or more templates can be defined for each document type.
A template can be selected for a new document.
A document is managed in versions.
Attachments are associated with a main document.
Additional information is added to a document.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in it.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Persons can be assigned to the distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to the distribution list.
Users can be assigned to user groups by technical administration.
Persons are assigned as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, readers, or initiators for a document.
User groups are assigned to documents for reader authorization, distribution, and archive access.
Signatures of workflow participants are documented for each released version.
Acknowledgements relate to the current released version.
Recipients confirm acknowledgement.
A document can be specified as visible or not visible in clients.
Attachments pass through the release statuses of the main document and affect the associated version.
